name: Side-by-Side (SBS)
summary: Left and right eye views placed horizontally side-by-side in a single frame. The most widely supported 3D format — accepted by passive 3D TVs, most AR glasses, and the majority of VR headsets when not using native VR mode.

variants.name: Full SBS
variants.description: Each eye gets the full horizontal resolution. Frame is twice the normal width (e.g. 3840×1080 for a 1080p source). Requires a display or app that accepts full SBS.

variants.name: Half SBS
variants.description: Each eye view is horizontally squeezed to half width, fitting both into a standard frame (e.g. 1920×1080). Most common format for 3DTVs and passive glasses. Some horizontal resolution loss.
